name: GH1899 Nen ~Aru Futari no Shinrai no Mori~
original_name: GH1899年～ある二人の信頼の森～
source:
From GH - Guggenheim Series

On a faraway planet on the cusp of a new millennium.
The prince of darkness reigns benevolently.
A strange fire has been started.
Terrorism? An enemy nation's resistance squad?
One can only speculate until time passes.

"These calm days a fire comes to play.
The shimmering heat deceives.
Mixed together it's good and evil and someone's strategy.
Who to trust? Who to doubt?
The fire burns, obscuring its master. Who is behind the flame?" 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105855.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
本作属于GH——古根海姆系列。

在一颗遥远的星球上，新千年即将到来。
黑暗之王以仁慈的方式统治着这里。
一场蹊跷的大火燃起。
是恐怖袭击？还是敌国抵抗组织所为？
在时间揭晓答案之前，人们只能猜测。

“平静的日子里，火焰前来嬉戏。
闪烁的热浪迷惑着人心。
善、恶与某人的计谋交织在一起。
该信任谁？又该怀疑谁？
火焰熊熊燃烧，将操纵它的人隐去。究竟是谁躲在火焰背后？”

（摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105855.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
